 3 die of dengue, 1,262 hospitalised in 24 hours
 Death toll rises to 418 this year 
 Published : 30 October 2026
 • 
 Updated : 30 October 2026, 17:29
 • 
 DISEASE
 SHARE 
 Star Online Report 
 At least three dengue patients died and 1,262 others were hospitalised in 24 hours till 8:00am today.
 All the deaths were reported in Dhaka division, according to the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS).
 Tap here to add The Daily Star as a trusted source 
 With the new deaths and cases, the total number of deaths this year rose to 418 and cases to 133,367.
 Currently, 6,236 dengue patients are undergoing treatment at different hospitals across the country.
